outOfScope: Changing default Oracle planner, facade or Core defaults outside the explicit profile publication.
A second attempt ledger, evidence manifest or Harbor adapter outside @exharness/benchmark.
Tuning thresholds or cohort after any held-out execution.
Claims of productivity or cost savings beyond the reduced gate outcome.
constraints: All units and attempts are registered through @exharness/benchmark public exports; UNKNOWN measurements stay null/UNKNOWN.
Cohort, arms, candidate profile digest and thresholds are frozen in a committed protocol before the first held-out attempt; the harness refuses to run otherwise.
The held-out cohort is disjoint from BB-065 calibration tasks and BB-077/BB-081 development and held-out digests.
Research consumes BB-094 and BB-065 as planned contracts; the Worker binds DONE BB-094 and BB-065.
Research only in this lane: no product source edits, no self-issued readiness or fabricated Jev judgment.
invariants: The decision is produced only by the frozen deterministic reducer from recorded attempts; Jev validates evidence but cannot change the outcome.
Any UNKNOWN required measurement, provenance violation or currentness violation prevents PUBLISH.
A supported Oracle profile is published only on PUBLISH_ORACLE_PROFILE_V1; foundation remains supported otherwise.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Protocol file scripts/oracle-context-intelligence/profile-acceptance-protocol.json = ORACLE_PROFILE_ACCEPTANCE_V1 {cohortRule, excludedDigests, arms, candidateProfile{digest, planningStrategy, budgetProfileId, progression}, fixedFactors, repeats: 2, gate, reducerVersion}; protocolDigest recorded before execution.

D2 — Cohort rule: from the Terminal-Bench 2.1 manifest pinned by BB-065, exclude BB-065 calibration digests and BB-077/BB-081 development and held-out digests, order remaining task digests by sha256(seed + digest) with seed fixed in the protocol, take the first 6. Selection is reproducible and not chosen by the Worker.

D3 — Arms: O0 STATIC_CONTEXT_CONTROL, O1 ORACLE_FOUNDATION_V1 (post BB-087), O2 frozen candidate composed from BB-091 decision, BB-093 budget profile and BB-092 progression policy; if BB-091 returned KEEP_DETERMINISTIC_V1, O2 uses DETERMINISTIC_V1 with the budget profile. Core profile = the supported profile recorded by BB-094.

D4 — Execution: harness scripts/oracle-context-intelligence/profile-acceptance.mjs --mode run registers the experiment, units (task x arm x repeat) and attempts via createExperimentRegistration, createBenchmarkUnit and AttemptLedger; balanced arm order per task; fresh session per unit; retries are new attempts.

D5 — Gate (preregistered, conjunctive, O2 vs O1): per-task accepted-success count O2 >= O1; zero provenance or currentness violations in O2; median prompt input tokens ratio O2/O1 <= 0.90; median normalized cost ratio <= 1.00; median elapsed ratio <= 1.10. Any required measurement UNKNOWN for a unit makes the gate INCONCLUSIVE.

D6 — Reducer oracle-profile-reducer returns PUBLISH_ORACLE_PROFILE_V1, KEEP_FOUNDATION or INCONCLUSIVE from recorded attempts and the protocol only; --mode reduce re-derives the decision from the ledger and must match the recorded decision.

D7 — Publication: only PUBLISH writes docs/living/system/oracle/profile-acceptance.md with ORACLE_PROFILE_V1 = candidate digest and binds protocolDigest, ledger audit and decision; KEEP_FOUNDATION or INCONCLUSIVE are recorded in the same doc without a supported-profile claim.
D8 — benchmark-profile.mjs: remove the vacuous `|| true` assertion and extend validate mode with the O2 arm and the D5 gate schema, keeping ORACLE_CONTEXT_BENCHMARK_V1 O0/O1 semantics.

D9 — Offline verification: reducer fixtures (publish, keep, inconclusive, unknown-measurement, violation) and protocol validation run in CI without credentials; the live run is Worker evidence attached through claimEvidence, never simulated.
implementationSlices: A1 — Protocol + cohort [PA1]: write the protocol per D1-D3, implement deterministic cohort selection and the pre-execution freeze check; tests prove disjointness and reproducibility.
A2 — Reducer [PA2]: implement D5-D6 with fixture ledgers for every outcome and the UNKNOWN/violation paths.

A3 — Harness + benchmark contract [PA1, PA3]: implement D4 against @exharness/benchmark public exports and D8 in benchmark-profile.mjs; offline tests cover registration shape with a stub substrate port.
A4 — Held-out run + publication [PA3]: execute --mode run on the frozen protocol, attach ledger/audit as claimEvidence, run --mode reduce, write the D7 Living Doc; run test:oracle and npm run verify.

negativeVerificationCases: Running --mode run with an uncommitted, modified or digest-mismatched protocol is refused before any attempt.
A cohort containing any BB-065 calibration or BB-077/BB-081 reserved digest fails selection; fewer than 6 eligible tasks stops PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
Re-running selection with the same seed yields a different cohort: test failure.
Any unit with UNKNOWN required tokens, cost or quality makes the decision INCONCLUSIVE, never PUBLISH.
Any provenance or currentness violation in O2 prevents PUBLISH even if all ratios pass.
A task where O2 accepted-success count is below O1 blocks PUBLISH regardless of aggregate ratios.
Reduce mode producing a decision different from the recorded one fails.
benchmark-profile.mjs retaining any `|| true` assertion fails the benchmark-contract test.
Writes under packages/** or benchmarks/substrate/** fail repository scope verification.
